interpretation.searchResultCount: the provider drawer contains candidate search results
interpretation.citationOccurrenceCount: the accepted answer contains the provider citations actually used by the answer
interpretation.deduplication: final citations are canonicalized and deduplicated by URL after extraction

failClosedRules: citation item must be rendered inside the accepted answer
citation item must carry provider data-id, data-group-key, and data-url
exactly one rendered source title must be present
unsafe, credentialed, overlong, untitled, or ambiguous citations reject the structured extraction
